snippet.title: DIVE OR DIE - Reveal trailer
snippet.description:
Don't let the rain touch you... Dive into the hostile abyss in this horror-survival. Build your camp, recruit survivors, and sacrifice what you must 🩸 DIVE or DIE - DEMO OUT NOW 🤿
👉 Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4321140/DIVE_or_DIE__Children_of_Rain_Demo/

What is DIVE OR DIE?
Dive into the hostile abyss in this horror-survival where every second counts. Scavenge and struggle against Eldritch horrors. Race the Flood to uncover idols. You have 40 days to save your camp and its desperate survivors.

DIVE or DIE is developed by Drop Rate Studio and published by Dear Villagers.
